result.brief: 提出 WorldCast 框架与 CLACT 数据集，利用深度反投影点云与几何对齐记忆注意力实现大角度相机轨迹下的世界一致角色视频生成。
result.reason: Large-angle camera-controlled character video generation with 3D point-cloud geometric guidance and geometry-aligned memory attention; contributes to controllable video generation and world-consistent modeling.
